subject: How many hyperparameters can INLA handle effectively?

messages.author: 17f8070912132195
messages.subject: How many hyperparameters can INLA handle effectively?
parts:
Dear INLA group,


How many hyperparameters can INLA handle effectively? I have developed a model with 18 hyperparameters, and it has been running for a long time. I am unsure if it would be better to simplify the model. What should I do if I want to maintain the current model structure and the number of hyperparameters? Really appreciate your guidance.


Thanks,

Ruby

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] How many hyperparameters can INLA handle effectively?
parts:
much more than before. its speed is basically determined by the number of cores
available. we have run with about 130 hyperparameters.

for testing purposed, then use

control.inla=list(int.strategy="eb")
